AI Overview
The full version of Geometry Dash requires a paid purchase, but several official and web-based free versions are available to play. 
Official Free Versions by RobTop Games
Geometry Dash Lite: The most popular free mobile version for iOS and Android, featuring a limited selection of official levels (up to 15 levels) with music-synced gameplay, but no level editor or full online features.
Geometry Dash Meltdown: A free standalone release featuring 3 levels (The Seven Seas, Viking Arena, and Airborne Robots).
Geometry Dash World: A free standalone release featuring 10 short, fast-paced levels with distinct worlds and rewards.
Geometry Dash SubZero: A free standalone release containing 3 levels (Press Start, Nock Em, and Power Trip) showcasing features from update 2.2. 
Free Browser Options
Web/HTML5 Ports: You can play Geometry Dash Lite and spin-offs like Geometry Dash SubZero directly in a web browser without downloading files or making an account. 
Community Spin-offs: Fan-made HTML5 projects like Geometry Dash Breeze provide custom community-designed rhythm levels for free in-browser play.
